tool.name: ART SOLiD
tool.help:
Art SOLiD Simulator ===================
ART_SOLiD is a simulation program to generate sequence read data of SOLiD sequencing reads. ART generates reads according to a SOLiD read error profile. The built-in error profile is an empiricial error profile summarized from large SOLiD sequencing data. ART has been using for testing or benchmarking a variety of method or tools for next-generation sequencing data analysis, including read alignment, de novo assembly, detection of SNP, CNV, or other structure variation.
art_SOLiD can generate both single-end, matepair, and paired-end of SOLiD - art art_src_MountRainier_Linux/ART_profiler_454/README: art_profiler_454 is the tool to generate a 454 read profile from 454 sequencing data in the fastq format. USAGE: ./art_profiler_454 input_fastq_files_dir output_profile_dir [fastq_filename_extension] PARAMETERS input_fastq_files_dir - directory containing all 454 read data files in the fastq format output_profile_dir - directory to put read profile files generated by the program sequencing platform. art_SOLiD also support amplicon sequencing simulation with RNA references.
